title: World-HoloBridge: governance reference prototype and community plan generator
description:
World-HoloBridge is a small, standard-library Python and SQLite reference prototype of a governance workflow for community-led cultural and spatial-media projects.

Gates. Contributor consent with expiry, withdrawal and prohibited uses (a prohibition in any active record wins); Indigenous material may only be registered by a contributor flagged as an Indigenous governance authority and is never marked for external AI training; non-public material cannot be attached to a project; four accessibility features are required; publication is blocked while any contract is unpaid or any contributor's consent has lapsed; guardrails cannot be disabled. It also records incidents, keeps an audit log made append-only by SQLite triggers, and exports a JSON impact report.

Community plan generator. For any city, region and country, it produces a starting plan from the framework's own rules (advisory circle, the five protocols, consent checklist, accessibility, payment before publication and contract template, incidents, AI-use assessment, a five-phase timeline, evaluation), in Python and in a static English/French web page (https://sparkainlp-x.github.io/world-holobridge/) that runs entirely in the browser. It never names Indigenous nations, communities or organizations or says whose territory a city is on; it directs users to identify and confirm rights-holders locally and directly with the communities, mentions native-land.ca only as a non-authoritative starting point, includes no local statistics, and notes that consent, privacy and Indigenous-data rules (e.g. OCAP®, CARE Principles) vary.

Provenance. The original script is kept unchanged in the repository; its own demo stopped at the consent gate (one contributor lacked community-storytelling consent). The working module fixes the demo and several robustness issues. 0.2.0 is the first release (0.1.0 was never released). 103 Python tests and 7 JavaScript tests run in CI on Python 3.10–3.13, including a Python/JavaScript parity test.

Limits. Reference prototype only: not legal advice, not a production system, and not a substitute for community-defined protocols. No endorsement by, or consultation with, any Wolastoqey community or other community is claimed. Names in the demo are placeholders.

License. Dual-licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0 at the user's option.
